sources.source: (let [events (atom []) m {:a (do (swap! events conj :a) 1) :b (do (swap! events conj :b) 2) :c (do (swap! events conj :c) 3) :d (do (swap! events conj :d) 4) :e (do (swap! events conj :e) 5) :f (do (swap! events conj :f) 6) :g (do (swap! events conj :g) 7) :h (do (swap! events conj :h) 8) :i (do (swap! events conj :i) 9)}] [(count m) @events])

(let [events (atom []) f (fn* [tag value] (swap! events conj tag) value) m {:a (f :v0 0) :b (f :v1 1) :c (f :v2 2) :d (f :v3 3) :e (f :v4 4) :f (f :v5 5) :g (f :v6 6) :h (f :v7 7)} output (with-out-str (println (count m)))] [(count m) (vec (seq m)) @events output])

(let [m '{nil :nil false :false true :true -2 :negative 1.5 :float :ns/key :keyword ns/name :symbol "text" :string \z :char}] [(count m) (get m nil) (vec (seq m))])

(let [m '{:a {:i 9 :h 8 :g 7 :f 6 :e 5 :d 4 :c 3 :b 2 :a 1} :b {:nil nil :s #{1 2} :v [3 4]} :c '(5 6) :d #{:x :y} :e [7 {:z 8}] :f nil :g true :h false :i x}] [(count m) (vec (seq m)) (vec (seq (:a m)))])
